name: Borgleden
description_md:
Borgleden is a waymarked hiking route in Norway covering 184.6 km. The line matches the official route published by turrutebasen as part of the national waymarked hiking network.

The path involves 2978 m of ascent and 3005 m of descent. Walking time is about 54 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The difficulty is hard, derived from distance and ascent. The route passes the Munch museum within 1500 m, Oslo (Torp) within 1800 m, and Oslo (Gardermoen) within 1800 m.
